org: oxwar
service: medical-scheduler
frameworkVersion: '4'

custom:
  eventBusName: ${self:service}-event-bus-${opt:stage, self:provider.stage}

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs18.x
  stage: dev
  region: us-east-1
  environment:
    DYNAMODB_TABLE: ${self:service}-${opt:stage, self:provider.stage}-appointments
    SNS_TOPIC: ${self:service}-${opt:stage, self:provider.stage}-appointment-topic
    SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref AppointmentSNSTopic
    SQS_PE: ${self:service}-sqs-pe-${opt:stage, self:provider.stage}
    SQS_CL: ${self:service}-sqs-cl-${opt:stage, self:provider.stage}
    SQS_RESULT: ${self:service}-sqs-result-${opt:stage, self:provider.stage}
    
    EVENT_BUS: ${self:custom.eventBusName}

    RDS_HOST: ${ssm:/medical-appointment-db/rds/host}
    RDS_PORT: ${ssm:/medical-appointment-db/rds/port}
    RDS_USER: ${ssm:/medical-appointment-db/rds/user}
    RDS_PASSWORD: ${ssm:/medical-appointment-db/rds/password}
    RDS_PE_DATABASE: ${ssm:/medical-appointment-db/rds/pe/database}
    RDS_CL_DATABASE: ${ssm:/medical-appointment-db/rds/cl/database}

  iamRoleStatements:
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - logs:CreateLogGroup
        - logs:CreateLogStream
        - logs:PutLogEvents
      Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - rds-db:connect
      Resource: "*"
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - dynamodb:PutItem
        - dynamodb:GetItem
        - dynamodb:UpdateItem
        - dynamodb:DeleteItem
        - dynamodb:Scan
        - dynamodb:Query
      Resource:
        - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.DYNAMODB_TABLE}
        - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.DYNAMODB_TABLE}/index/InsuredIdIndex
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - sns:Publish
      Resource:
        - arn:aws:sns:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:${self:provider.environment.SNS_TOPIC}
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - sqs:SendMessage
        - sqs:ReceiveMessage
        - sqs:DeleteMessage
        - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
      Resource:
        - !GetAtt SQSPE.Arn
        - !GetAtt SQSCL.Arn
        - !GetAtt SQSResult.Arn
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - "ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces"
        - "ec2:CreateNetworkInterface"
        - "ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface"
        - "ec2:DescribeInstances"
        - "ec2:AttachNetworkInterface"
      Resource: "*"
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - events:PutEvents
      Resource:
        - arn:aws:events:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:event-bus/${self:custom.eventBusName}

functions:
  appointment:
    handler: src/infrastructure/handlers/appointment.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /appointments
          method: post
      - httpApi:
          path: /appointments
          method: get
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt SQSResult.Arn


  appointment_pe:
    handler: src/infrastructure/handlers/pe-processor.handler
    environment:
      COUNTRY_ISO: 'PE'
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt SQSPE.Arn

  appointment_cl:
    handler: src/infrastructure/handlers/cl-processor.handler
    environment:
      COUNTRY_ISO: 'CL'
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt SQSCL.Arn

resources:
  Resources:
    AppointmentsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.DYNAMODB_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: insuredId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: InsuredIdIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: insuredId
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
    
    AppointmentEventBus:
      Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
      Properties:
        Name: ${self:custom.eventBusName}

    EventBridgeRuleToStatusQueue:
      Type: AWS::Events::Rule
      Properties:
        EventBusName: !Ref AppointmentEventBus
        EventPattern:
          source:
            - "appointments"
          # detail-type:
          #   - "AppointmentProcessed"
        Targets:
          - Arn: !GetAtt SQSResult.Arn
            Id: SendToResultQueue

    SQSResult:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: ${self:provider.environment.SQS_RESULT}
        VisibilityTimeout: 300

    SQSResultQueuePolicy:
      Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
      Properties:
        Queues:
          - !Ref SQSResult
        PolicyDocument:
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: events.amazonaws.com
              Action: sqs:SendMessage
              Resource: !GetAtt SQSResult.Arn

    SQSPE:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: ${self:provider.environment.SQS_PE}
        VisibilityTimeout: 300

    SQSPEQueuePolicy:
      Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
      Properties:
        Queues:
          - !Ref SQSPE
        PolicyDocument:
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: sns.amazonaws.com
              Action: sqs:SendMessage
              Resource: !GetAtt SQSPE.Arn
              Condition:
                ArnEquals:
                  aws:SourceArn: !Ref AppointmentSNSTopic

    SQSCL:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: ${self:provider.environment.SQS_CL}
        VisibilityTimeout: 300

    SQSCLQueuePolicy:
      Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
      Properties:
        Queues:
          - !Ref SQSCL
        PolicyDocument:
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: sns.amazonaws.com
              Action: sqs:SendMessage
              Resource: !GetAtt SQSCL.Arn
              Condition:
                ArnEquals:
                  aws:SourceArn: !Ref AppointmentSNSTopic

    AppointmentSNSTopic:
      Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
      Properties:
        TopicName: ${self:provider.environment.SNS_TOPIC}

    SNSPESubscription:
      Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
      Properties:
        TopicArn: !Ref AppointmentSNSTopic
        Protocol: sqs
        Endpoint: !GetAtt SQSPE.Arn
        FilterPolicy:
          countryISO: ["PE"]

    SNSCLSubscription:
      Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
      Properties:
        TopicArn: !Ref AppointmentSNSTopic
        Protocol: sqs
        Endpoint: !GetAtt SQSCL.Arn
        FilterPolicy:
          countryISO: ["CL"]
